player_prompt.intro:
Ame nye Aka {player_id} le Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma si woɖe {num_rounds} ɣleti.

Agbale si:
- Le ɣleti ɖesiaɖe la, awoe {total_conversation_rounds} ɣletiwo be na alesiɖe.
- Emea, aka siawo katã ade si be woakpɔtɔ kple woade.

Payoff Matrix (ɖeɖe ɣleti):
- Aka siawo katã ade ɖoɖo ➜ aka {cooperate_reward}
- Aka siawo katã ade ade ➜ aka {mutual_defect_reward}
- Aka ɖeka ade, aka ɖeka ɖoɖo ➜ Aka ade {defect_reward}, Aka ɖoɖo {sucker_reward}

Ne eme na:
- Le alesiɖe: ŋkɔ ŋu alesi be woawo.
- Le ɣleti si: ɖe '[Cooperate]' alo '[Defect]' (meɖeɖe o). Awoe ade ŋu alesi ɖeɖe.

phases.conversation_finished: Nuxɔxɔxɔ ɖɔɖɔe le round {round}. Mɔ na mi be yɛ '[Cooperate]' kple '[Defect]' le  oxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Ŋutsu eveawo siaa wɔ dɔ aduadu.
outcome.round_both_defect: Wo ame evea siaa trɔ le woƒe dzi me.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Fefewɔla 0 wɔ nu aduadu, eye fefenu 1 dzo.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Fefewɔla 0 to, eye fefenu 1 wɔ dɔ aduadu.
